summary: recent_events hands a model the tail of the journal as sequences, kinds and a privacy class, and never a word of game text

coordination.notes: Reads the journal through the same readFrom query every other consumer uses, structurally typed so this module imports nothing from aiEventJournal.ts and a test needs no journal. The privacy class is read off the payload rather than re-derived here: G12 classifies at ingest from the stream id the bridge already labelled, and a second opinion computed in a tool would be a second parser of game text. The fixture deliberately carries text on every payload, including a whisper, so the check runs against a population where the wrong answer is available - a tool that dropped text only because its fixture had none would pass a test that proves nothing. The private-comms exclusion itself is G12; this increment carries the class so G12 has something to filter on.
